sources.title: Ravens place QBs Lamar Jackson, Tyler Huntley on injured reserve
sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens placed quarterbacks Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on injured reserve on Thursday ahead of their Week 9 matchup with the Jacksonville Jaguars.
